title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The same picker, two different sentences
summary: Three pickers said one thing on the desktop and another in the browser, each reworded on its own side by the same copy pass.

highlights.title: One sentence, two builds
highlights.description: Multiple matches, pick the implementation file on the desktop against Multiple matches. Pick implementation file in the browser. The browser now says what the desktop says, to the word.

highlights.title: Checked from now on
highlights.description: A test reads both entry points and requires every picker the browser shows to exist word for word on the desktop side.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The three pickers of go to test, go to preview and copy the qualified name read the same in the browser as on the desktop.
The string folding scan logs the files it actually looks for.
